lines.text: Why did Supreme sell for $600M less than it cost?
lines.say: Why did Supreme sell for six hundred million less?

lines.text: VF Corp paid $2.1B for Supreme in 2020, then sold it to EssilorLuxottica for $1.5B in 2024.
lines.say: VF paid two point one billion in twenty twenty, and sold it for one point five billion in twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: $2.1B - $1.5B = $600M less, about 29% below what VF paid.
lines.say: That's six hundred million less, about twenty-nine percent below what VF paid.

lines.text: Supreme drops new items on Thursdays each season, in small batches that often sell out and resell for more.
lines.say: Here's the model: new items drop on Thursdays each season, in small batches that often sell out and resell for more.

lines.text: Under VF, Supreme's revenue fell from $561.5M in fiscal 2022 to $523.1M, then reached only $538M in fiscal 2024.
lines.say: Under VF, yearly revenue fell from five hundred sixty-one million to five twenty-three, then recovered only to five thirty-eight.

lines.text: In fiscal 2023, VF wrote down Supreme's value by about $735M.
lines.say: VF also wrote down Supreme's value by about seven hundred thirty-five million dollars.

lines.text: In July 2024, VF's CEO cited "limited synergies" with Supreme, and the cash helped pay down debt.
lines.say: VF's CEO cited limited synergies, and the cash helped pay down debt.

lines.text: Buyer EssilorLuxottica, owner of Ray-Ban, said Supreme offers "a direct connection to new audiences."

post.title: Why Supreme sold for $600M less than VF paid for it
post.ig:
Why did Supreme sell for $600M less than it cost?

VF Corp paid $2.1B for Supreme in Dec 2020 and sold it to EssilorLuxottica for $1.5B in Oct 2024: $600M less, about 29% lower.
Supreme's model: in-season Thursday drops in small batches that often sell out and resell for more.
Under VF, Supreme's revenue was $561.5M in fiscal 2022 and $538M in fiscal 2024, and VF wrote down about $735M of its value in fiscal 2023.

Sources: VF Corp 10-K filings (FY2022-FY2024), VF and EssilorLuxottica release (July 2024), Bloomberg, WWD.
